head: oval, flush SEMS washer (size of GM replacement 11500421, not confirmed for the 1970 original)
notes: SCREW ASM. No hits for the number (bare, Chevrolet, Corvette console context). Round 4: CorvetteForum owner reports GM parts wiki supersedes 3922441 (1971 AIM p. L108 interior trim screw) to 11500421; Auveco 2775 cross-references GM 11500421 as #8 x 7/8 Phillips oval-head SEMS tapping screw (flush washer, chrome). Size is from the superseding number via Auveco cross-ref; original may differ in finish (forum notes service screws could be black vs plated originals). Tracy sells it as 68-76 radio side panel screw.

sources.title: interior screws, did I get screwed? - CorvetteForum
sources.quote: I looked in my 1971 AIM on page L108 and the part # for the screw is 3922441. According to this GM parts wiki I found, that part has been replaced by 11500421.
